inlines.v: AD'AMANT, noun [ Gr.; Latin adamas; a word of Celtic origin.] A very hard or impenetrable stone; a name given to the diamond and other substances of extreme hardness. The name has often been given to the load stone; but in modern mineralogy, it has no technical signification.
